FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_PortShuttle_LSM_YawSteering
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* LUMINA CYBER-PHYSICAL ADVANCED AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE - CONTAINER TERMINAL AUTOMATION    *)
(* COMPONENT: FB_PortShuttle_LSM_YawSteering                                                 *)
(* APPLICATION: Port Automated Container Shuttle (PACS) Heavy Payload High-Dynamics Transfer *)
(* FUNCTION: Bilateral Dual Linear Synchronous Motor (LSM) Differential Thrust Steering,     *)
(*           Active Bogie Articulation, State-Space Estimator & 2oo3 TMR Fault Tolerance     *)
(* SYSTEM CLOCK: 5.0 ms Cyclic Synchronous Real-Time Task Execution (T_SAMPLE = 0.005 s)    *)
(* DESIGNED PER IEC 61131-3 3RD ED. / ISO 13849-1 PL e / IEC 61508 SIL 3 ARCHITECTURE       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Safety & Enable Interlocks --- *)
    bEnable                     : BOOL;     (* Master functional block execution enable [TRUE=Run, FALSE=Safe Passive] *)
    bEStopOk                    : BOOL;     (* Dual-channel hardware E-stop safety loop [TRUE=Healthy, FALSE=Tripped] *)
    bResetFault                 : BOOL;     (* Rising-edge pulse to acknowledge and reset non-fatal latch faults *)

    (* --- Kinematics & Payload Physical Measurements --- *)
    rLongitudinalVelocity_mps   : REAL;     (* Shuttle forward velocity along guideway axis [m/s] *)
    rLongitudinalAccel_mps2     : REAL;     (* Shuttle forward acceleration measured by longitudinal accelerometer [m/s^2] *)
    rPayloadMass_ton            : REAL;     (* Container payload gross weight from twistlock load cells [ton] (0.0 to 45.0) *)
    rTargetThrust_kN            : REAL;     (* Master supervisory traction controller net thrust command [kN] *)

    (* --- Guidance & Advance Track Profile --- *)
    rTrackCurvature_radpm       : REAL;     (* Feedforward guideway horizontal curvature profile kappa = 1/R [rad/m] *)
    rCrosswindForce_kN          : REAL;     (* Ultrasonic anemometer estimated lateral aerodynamic disturbance force [kN] *)

    (* --- Redundant Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Gyroscopes --- *)
    rYawRate_GyroA_degps        : REAL;     (* Fiber Optic Gyroscope Channel A chassis yaw rate [deg/s] *)
    rYawRate_GyroB_degps        : REAL;     (* Fiber Optic Gyroscope Channel B chassis yaw rate [deg/s] *)
    rYawRate_GyroC_degps        : REAL;     (* MEMS Gyroscope Channel C chassis yaw rate [deg/s] *)

    (* --- Redundant Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Lateral Guideway Displacement Sensors --- *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m      : REAL;     (* Optical/Laser Track Centerline Lateral Offset Channel A [m] *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m      : REAL;     (* Magnetic Inductive Guideway Sensor Channel B [m] *)
    rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m      : REAL;     (* Time-of-Flight Radar Guideway Sensor Channel C [m] *)

    (* --- LSM Electrical Feedback & Bogie Feedback --- *)
    rPortActualCurrent_A        : REAL;     (* Port (Left) Linear Motor inverter q-axis torque current [A] *)
    rStbdActualCurrent_A        : REAL;     (* Starboard (Right) Linear Motor inverter q-axis torque current [A] *)
    rBogieSteerAngleFb_rad      : REAL;     (* Rotary absolute encoder bogie articulation angle feedback [rad] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Primary Actuator Thrust & Angle Commands --- *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Steering & yaw control loop operational and in closed-loop state *)
    rPortThrustCmd_kN           : REAL;     (* Port stator linear synchronous motor thrust command [kN] *)
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN           : REAL;     (* Starboard stator linear synchronous motor thrust command [kN] *)
    rDifferentialForce_kN       : REAL;     (* Differential yaw torque control force Delta_Fx = F_stbd - F_port [kN] *)
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     : REAL;     (* Electro-hydraulic/electric bogie steering actuator angle setpoint [rad] *)

    (* --- State Estimation & Observation Outputs --- *)
    rVotedLateralDispl_m        : REAL;     (* 2oo3 validated guideway lateral displacement [m] *)
    rVotedYawRate_radps         : REAL;     (* 2oo3 validated vehicle yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rEstimatedYawAngle_rad      : REAL;     (* Discrete observer estimated chassis yaw angle relative to guideway [rad] *)
    rEstimatedLateralVel_mps    : REAL;     (* Discrete observer estimated lateral drift velocity [m/s] *)

    (* --- Diagnostics, Status Words & Safety Flags --- *)
    wOperatingState             : WORD;     (* Current internal finite state machine operational code *)
    wDiagnosticWord             : WORD;     (* Real-time fault bitmask register for SCADA telemetry *)
    bDegradedMode               : BOOL;     (* True if operating under single sensor fallback (2oo2 / 1oo1) *)
    bFlangeContactWarning       : BOOL;     (* Flange clearance below critical threshold (< 6.0 mm) *)
    bEmergencyBrakingActive     : BOOL;     (* Emergency dynamic and friction brake override triggered *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Internal State Machine Variables --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Primary sequencer state index *)
    iPreviousState              : INT := 0; (* Previous state for edge transition detection *)
    tonStateTimer               : TON;      (* State residence duration timer *)
    tonSensorMismatchTimer      : TON;      (* Persistent sensor discrepancy debounce timer *)

    (* --- Physical & Geometric Parameters (Port Shuttle Model 65t) --- *)
    rMassTare_kg                : REAL := 18500.0;  (* Chassis tare empty mass [kg] *)
    rTotalMass_kg               : REAL := 18500.0;  (* Total vehicle plus payload operational mass [kg] *)
    rBogieTrackHalfWidth_b_m    : REAL := 1.250;    (* Half-track distance from centerline to LSM stator centerline [m] *)
    rWheelbase_L_m              : REAL := 9.800;    (* Longitudinal distance between front and rear bogie pivots [m] *)
    rYawInertia_Jz_kgm2         : REAL := 220000.0; (* Chassis yaw moment of inertia [kg*m^2] *)
    rMaxLSMThrust_kN            : REAL := 85.0;     (* Peak individual LSM thrust limit [kN] *)
    rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN   : REAL := 60.0;     (* Maximum allowable differential thrust [kN] *)
    rMaxSteeringAngle_rad       : REAL := 0.1745;   (* Maximum mechanical bogie steering angle (+/- 10.0 deg) [rad] *)
    rSamplingPeriod_Ts_s        : REAL := 0.005;    (* 5 ms sample time [s] *)
    rDegToRad                   : REAL := 0.017453292519943; (* Conversion constant [deg -> rad] *)
    rRadToDeg                   : REAL := 57.29577951308232; (* Conversion constant [rad -> deg] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Voting Variables & Sensor Health Status --- *)
    rYawRateA_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch A yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rYawRateB_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch B yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    rYawRateC_radps             : REAL;     (* Converted Ch C yaw rate [rad/s] *)
    bGyroA_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro A health validation flag *)
    bGyroB_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro B health validation flag *)
    bGyroC_Valid                : BOOL;     (* Gyro C health validation flag *)
    rDiffGyro_AB                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |A - B| [rad/s] *)
    rDiffGyro_BC                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |B - C| [rad/s] *)
    rDiffGyro_CA                : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |C - A| [rad/s] *)
    rGyroTolerance_radps        : REAL := 0.035; (* 2.0 deg/s allowable discrepancy threshold *)

    bDisplA_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor A health flag *)
    bDisplB_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor B health flag *)
    bDisplC_Valid               : BOOL;     (* Lateral displacement Sensor C health flag *)
    rDiffDispl_AB               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |A - B| [m] *)
    rDiffDispl_BC               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |B - C| [m] *)
    rDiffDispl_CA               : REAL;     (* Absolute discrepancy |C - A| [m] *)
    rDisplTolerance_m           : REAL := 0.008; (* 8.0 mm allowable sensor discrepancy threshold *)

    (* --- 4-State Discrete Luenberger Observer / Estimator --- *)
    (* States: x[0] = y (lateral pos [m]), x[1] = y_dot (lateral vel [m/s]), *)
    (*         x[2] = psi (yaw error [rad]), x[3] = psi_dot (yaw rate [rad/s]) *)
    x_hat_0                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Lateral position estimate [m] *)
    x_hat_1                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Lateral velocity estimate [m/s] *)
    x_hat_2                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Yaw error angle estimate [rad] *)
    x_hat_3                     : REAL := 0.0; (* Yaw rate estimate [rad/s] *)

    (* Discrete Observer Prediction Pre-Calculated Matrices (Taylor Series 2nd Order discretised at Ts=5ms) *)
    (* Ad = I + Ac*Ts + 0.5*(Ac*Ts)^2 *)
    ad_00 : REAL := 1.0000;  ad_01 : REAL := 0.0050;  ad_02 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_03 : REAL := 0.0000;
    ad_10 : REAL := -0.0450; ad_11 : REAL := 0.9850;  ad_12 : REAL := 0.1200;  ad_13 : REAL := 0.0025;
    ad_20 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_21 : REAL := 0.0000;  ad_22 : REAL := 1.0000;  ad_23 : REAL := 0.0050;
    ad_30 : REAL := -0.0120; ad_31 : REAL := -0.0050; ad_32 : REAL := -0.0850; ad_33 : REAL := 0.9780;

    (* Input matrix Bd for u = [Delta_Fx (kN), BogieAngle (rad)] *)
    bd_00 : REAL := 0.00000;  bd_01 : REAL := 0.00010;
    bd_10 : REAL := 0.00012;  bd_11 : REAL := 0.01850;
    bd_20 : REAL := 0.00000;  bd_21 : REAL := 0.00025;
    bd_30 : REAL := 0.00065;  bd_31 : REAL := 0.04200;

    (* Observer Innovation Correction Gains L (Dual output y_meas, psi_dot_meas) *)
    l_00 : REAL := 0.1850;  l_01 : REAL := 0.0005;
    l_10 : REAL := 0.4200;  l_11 : REAL := 0.0150;
    l_20 : REAL := 0.0080;  l_21 : REAL := 0.1250;
    l_30 : REAL := 0.0250;  l_31 : REAL := 0.4800;

    (* --- State Feedback & Model Predictive Controller Gains --- *)
    (* Optimal Linear Quadratic Regulator Gains K for [y, y_dot, psi, psi_dot] *)
    k_diff_y                    : REAL := 145.0;    (* Differential thrust per meter lateral displacement [kN/m] *)
    k_diff_ydot                 : REAL := 32.0;     (* Differential thrust per m/s lateral velocity [kN/(m/s)] *)
    k_diff_psi                  : REAL := 285.0;    (* Differential thrust per radian yaw angle [kN/rad] *)
    k_diff_psidot               : REAL := 48.0;     (* Differential thrust per rad/s yaw rate [kN/(rad/s)] *)

    k_steer_y                   : REAL := 0.380;    (* Bogie steer angle per meter lateral displacement [rad/m] *)
    k_steer_ydot                : REAL := 0.085;    (* Bogie steer angle per m/s lateral velocity [rad/(m/s)] *)
    k_steer_psi                 : REAL := 0.920;    (* Bogie steer angle per radian yaw error [rad/rad] *)
    k_steer_psidot              : REAL := 0.140;    (* Bogie steer angle per rad/s yaw rate [rad/(rad/s)] *)

    (* --- Feedforward Calculation Registers --- *)
    rFeedforwardDifferential_kN : REAL := 0.0;     (* Curvature and wind feedforward differential thrust *)
    rFeedforwardSteer_rad       : REAL := 0.0;     (* Curvature kinematic Ackerman bogie feedforward *)
    rWindCompThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;     (* Crosswind aerodynamic counter-torque thrust *)

    (* --- Integrator Accumulator for Steady-State Offset Rejection --- *)
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s   : REAL := 0.0;     (* Integral of lateral guideway displacement [m*s] *)
    k_integral_y                : REAL := 18.0;     (* Integrator gain for differential thrust [kN/(m*s)] *)
    rIntegralLimit_m_s          : REAL := 0.250;    (* Anti-windup clamping envelope on integral accumulator *)

    (* --- Rate Limiter Variables --- *)
    rPrevPortThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN          : REAL := 0.0;
    rMaxThrustSlewRate_kNps     : REAL := 250.0;    (* Maximum allowable slew rate 250 kN/sec *)
    rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN         : REAL := 1.25;     (* 250 * 0.005s = 1.25 kN per 5ms execution cycle *)

    (* --- Constant Status & Alarm Bitmask Definitions --- *)
    ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT            : WORD := 16#0001;  (* Bit 0: Hardware E-Stop open *)
    GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0002;  (* Bit 1: Gyro A discrepancy isolated *)
    GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0004;  (* Bit 2: Gyro B discrepancy isolated *)
    GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT            : WORD := 16#0008;  (* Bit 3: Gyro C discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0010;  (* Bit 4: Lateral sensor A discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0020;  (* Bit 5: Lateral sensor B discrepancy isolated *)
    DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT           : WORD := 16#0040;  (* Bit 6: Lateral sensor C discrepancy isolated *)
    TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT     : WORD := 16#0080;  (* Bit 7: Dual sensor disagreement - TMR loss *)
    LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT  : WORD := 16#0100;  (* Bit 8: Guideway lateral offset exceeded limit (> 40mm) *)
    YAW_RATE_EXCEEDED_BIT       : WORD := 16#0200;  (* Bit 9: Vehicle yaw angular velocity exceeded limit *)
    CURRENT_ASYMMETRY_WARN_BIT  : WORD := 16#0400;  (* Bit 10: LSM phase currents severe imbalance *)
    CROSSWIND_SEVERE_BIT        : WORD := 16#0800;  (* Bit 11: Severe lateral gale gust compensation active *)
    ACTUATOR_SLEW_CLAMP_BIT     : WORD := 16#1000;  (* Bit 12: Bogie or LSM rate limiter operating at ceiling *)
    OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT  : WORD := 16#2000;  (* Bit 13: Kalman/Observer innovation residual divergence *)
    DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT      : WORD := 16#4000;  (* Bit 14: Degraded sub-optimal performance active *)
    SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT          : WORD := 16#8000;  (* Bit 15: Critical safety fault lockout latched *)
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCK AND EMERGENCY OVERRIDE EVALUATION                           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate de-energization of bilateral thrust and fail-safe mechanical brake drop *)
    rPortThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
    rDifferentialForce_kN       := 0.0;
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     := 0.0;
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    bEmergencyBrakingActive     := TRUE;
    wOperatingState             := 16#0090; (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY_BRAKE *)
    wDiagnosticWord             := wDiagnosticWord OR ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT OR SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT;
    iState                      := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Clear E-Stop bit if loop is healthy *)
wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT ESTOP_ACTIVE_BIT;

(* Fault reset acknowledgement on rising edge *)
IF bResetFault THEN
    IF (wDiagnosticWord AND SAFETY_LOCKOUT_BIT) = 0 THEN
        wDiagnosticWord := 16#0000;
        bFlangeContactWarning := FALSE;
        rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Total operational mass calculation accounting for payload dynamics *)
rTotalMass_kg := rMassTare_kg + (LIMIT(0.0, rPayloadMass_ton, 45.0) * 1000.0);
(* Scale yaw moment of inertia dynamically with container payload mass *)
rYawInertia_Jz_kgm2 := 120000.0 + (rTotalMass_kg * 4.25);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING AND FAULT DETECTION LOGIC                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert incoming Gyro measurements from deg/s to rad/s *)
rYawRateA_radps := rYawRate_GyroA_degps * rDegToRad;
rYawRateB_radps := rYawRate_GyroB_degps * rDegToRad;
rYawRateC_radps := rYawRate_GyroC_degps * rDegToRad;

(* Pairwise difference computation for Gyro channels *)
rDiffGyro_AB := ABS(rYawRateA_radps - rYawRateB_radps);
rDiffGyro_BC := ABS(rYawRateB_radps - rYawRateC_radps);
rDiffGyro_CA := ABS(rYawRateC_radps - rYawRateA_radps);

bGyroA_Valid := TRUE;
bGyroB_Valid := TRUE;
bGyroC_Valid := TRUE;

(* Tri-channel voting arbitration for Yaw Rate *)
IF (rDiffGyro_AB <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA <= rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* All three sensors concordant: Standard median / middle-value selection *)
    IF (rYawRateA_radps >= rYawRateB_radps AND rYawRateA_radps <= rYawRateC_radps) OR (rYawRateA_radps <= rYawRateB_radps AND rYawRateA_radps >= rYawRateC_radps) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateA_radps;
    ELSIF (rYawRateB_radps >= rYawRateA_radps AND rYawRateB_radps <= rYawRateC_radps) OR (rYawRateB_radps <= rYawRateA_radps AND rYawRateB_radps >= rYawRateC_radps) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateB_radps;
    ELSE
        rVotedYawRate_radps := rYawRateC_radps;
    END_IF;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_AB <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel C drifted / failed: Isolate C, average A and B *)
    bGyroC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateA_radps + rYawRateB_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_BC <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_AB > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_CA > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel A drifted / failed: Isolate A, average B and C *)
    bGyroA_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateB_radps + rYawRateC_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffGyro_CA <= rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_AB > rGyroTolerance_radps) AND (rDiffGyro_BC > rGyroTolerance_radps) THEN
    (* Channel B drifted / failed: Isolate B, average C and A *)
    bGyroB_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateC_radps + rYawRateA_radps) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR GYRO_B_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (GYRO_A_FAULT_BIT OR GYRO_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSE
    (* Total TMR disagreement: More than 1 sensor diverged *)
    bGyroA_Valid := FALSE;
    bGyroB_Valid := FALSE;
    bGyroC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedYawRate_radps := (rYawRateA_radps + rYawRateB_radps + rYawRateC_radps) / 3.0;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Pairwise difference computation for Guideway Displacement sensors *)
rDiffDispl_AB := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m);
rDiffDispl_BC := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m);
rDiffDispl_CA := ABS(rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m - rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m);

bDisplA_Valid := TRUE;
bDisplB_Valid := TRUE;
bDisplC_Valid := TRUE;

(* Tri-channel voting arbitration for Lateral Guideway Position *)
IF (rDiffDispl_AB <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA <= rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* All sensors healthy: Median voter *)
    IF (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) OR (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) THEN
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m;
    ELSIF (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) OR (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m <= rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m AND rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m >= rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) THEN
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m;
    ELSE
        rVotedLateralDispl_m := rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m;
    END_IF;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_AB <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ C failed *)
    bDisplC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_BC <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_AB > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_CA > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ A failed *)
    bDisplA_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSIF (rDiffDispl_CA <= rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_AB > rDisplTolerance_m) AND (rDiffDispl_BC > rDisplTolerance_m) THEN
    (* Displ B failed *)
    bDisplB_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m) * 0.5;
    wDiagnosticWord := (wDiagnosticWord OR DISPL_B_FAULT_BIT) AND NOT (DISPL_A_FAULT_BIT OR DISPL_C_FAULT_BIT);
ELSE
    (* Total TMR disagreement on Displacement *)
    bDisplA_Valid := FALSE;
    bDisplB_Valid := FALSE;
    bDisplC_Valid := FALSE;
    rVotedLateralDispl_m := (rGuidewayDispl_SensA_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensB_m + rGuidewayDispl_SensC_m) / 3.0;
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Determine Degraded Mode Flag *)
bDegradedMode := NOT (bGyroA_Valid AND bGyroB_Valid AND bGyroC_Valid AND bDisplA_Valid AND bDisplB_Valid AND bDisplC_Valid);
IF bDegradedMode THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT DEGRADED_OPERATION_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Flange contact avoidance warning if offset exceeds +/- 28 mm *)
bFlangeContactWarning := (ABS(rVotedLateralDispl_m) > 0.028);
IF ABS(rVotedLateralDispl_m) > 0.040 THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT LATERAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BIT;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 FOUR-STATE DISCRETE LUENBERGER OBSERVER UPDATE                                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Prediction Phase: x_pred = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u *)
VAR_TEMP
    x_pred_0    : REAL;
    x_pred_1    : REAL;
    x_pred_2    : REAL;
    x_pred_3    : REAL;
    rInnov_0    : REAL;
    rInnov_1    : REAL;
    rDiffForce_u: REAL;
    rSteer_u    : REAL;
    rLsmTotalThrust_kN : REAL;
    rRawPortThrust_kN  : REAL;
    rRawStbdThrust_kN  : REAL;
    rSlewClampedPort_kN: REAL;
    rSlewClampedStbd_kN: REAL;
END_VAR

rDiffForce_u := rDifferentialForce_kN;
rSteer_u     := rBogieSteerAngleFb_rad;

(* State propagation equations *)
x_pred_0 := (ad_00 * x_hat_0) + (ad_01 * x_hat_1) + (ad_02 * x_hat_2) + (ad_03 * x_hat_3) + (bd_00 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_01 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_1 := (ad_10 * x_hat_0) + (ad_11 * x_hat_1) + (ad_12 * x_hat_2) + (ad_13 * x_hat_3) + (bd_10 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_11 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_2 := (ad_20 * x_hat_0) + (ad_21 * x_hat_1) + (ad_22 * x_hat_2) + (ad_23 * x_hat_3) + (bd_20 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_21 * rSteer_u);
x_pred_3 := (ad_30 * x_hat_0) + (ad_31 * x_hat_1) + (ad_32 * x_hat_2) + (ad_33 * x_hat_3) + (bd_30 * rDiffForce_u) + (bd_31 * rSteer_u);

(* Innovation Residual: Measured minus Predicted Output *)
rInnov_0 := rVotedLateralDispl_m - x_pred_0;
rInnov_1 := rVotedYawRate_radps  - x_pred_3;

(* Check for observer divergence *)
IF (ABS(rInnov_0) > 0.050) OR (ABS(rInnov_1) > 0.25) THEN
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT OBSERVER_RESIDUAL_HIGH_BIT;
END_IF;

(* Correction Phase: x_hat = x_pred + L * Innovation *)
x_hat_0 := x_pred_0 + (l_00 * rInnov_0) + (l_01 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_1 := x_pred_1 + (l_10 * rInnov_0) + (l_11 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_2 := x_pred_2 + (l_20 * rInnov_0) + (l_21 * rInnov_1);
x_hat_3 := x_pred_3 + (l_30 * rInnov_0) + (l_31 * rInnov_1);

(* Export filtered observer states to functional block outputs *)
rEstimatedLateralVel_mps := x_hat_1;
rEstimatedYawAngle_rad   := x_hat_2;

(* Integral accumulation with anti-windup *)
IF bEnable AND (iState = 20 OR iState = 30 OR iState = 40) THEN
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := LIMIT(-rIntegralLimit_m_s, rDisplacementIntegral_m_s + (x_hat_0 * rSamplingPeriod_Ts_s), rIntegralLimit_m_s);
ELSE
    rDisplacementIntegral_m_s := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 FINITE STATE MACHINE: SUPERVISORY CONTROL AND GRACEFUL DEGRADATION                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tonStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

tonSensorMismatchTimer(IN := ((wDiagnosticWord AND TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT) <> 0), PT := T#150MS);

CASE iState OF
    0: (* --- STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & BUILT-IN SELF TEST --- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rPortThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
        rStbdThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
        rDifferentialForce_kN       := 0.0;
        rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     := 0.0;
        x_hat_0                     := 0.0;
        x_hat_1                     := 0.0;
        x_hat_2                     := 0.0;
        x_hat_3                     := 0.0;
        rDisplacementIntegral_m_s   := 0.0;
        wOperatingState             := 16#0000;

        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby Levitation / Align *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* --- STATE 10: STANDBY ALIGNMENT & PRE-FLIGHT VERIFICATION --- *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        rPortThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
        rStbdThrustCmd_kN           := 0.0;
        rDifferentialForce_kN       := 0.0;
        rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad     := 0.0;
        wOperatingState             := 16#000A;

        (* Check current symmetry between bilateral stators *)
        IF ABS(rPortActualCurrent_A - rStbdActualCurrent_A) > 60.0 THEN
            wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR CURRENT_ASYMMETRY_WARN_BIT;
        ELSE
            wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT CURRENT_ASYMMETRY_WARN_BIT;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        ELSIF (wDiagnosticWord AND TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT) <> 0 THEN
            iState := 80; (* Sensor collapse, abort to controlled stop *)
        ELSIF tonStateTimer.ET >= T#500MS THEN
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Normal Run *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* --- STATE 20: NORMAL DUAL LSM YAW & STEERING TRACKING --- *)
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        wOperatingState := 16#0014;

        (* Check transition conditions *)
        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF tonSensorMismatchTimer.Q THEN
            iState := 80; (* Sustained TMR sensor loss *)
        ELSIF bDegradedMode THEN
            iState := 50; (* Single sensor drop, switch to degraded mode *)
        ELSIF ABS(rTrackCurvature_radpm) > 0.002 THEN
            iState := 30; (* Significant curve detected, enter curve negotiation *)
        ELSIF ABS(rCrosswindForce_kN) > 15.0 THEN
            iState := 40; (* High lateral wind detected *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* --- STATE 30: ADVANCE CURVE NEGOTIATION WITH FEEDFORWARD --- *)
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        wOperatingState := 16#001E;

        IF NOT bEnable OR tonSensorMismatchTimer.Q THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF bDegradedMode THEN
            iState := 50;
        ELSIF (ABS(rTrackCurvature_radpm) <= 0.001) AND (tonStateTimer.ET > T#200MS) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Return to tangent track tracking *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* --- STATE 40: EXTREME CROSSWIND REJECTION MODE --- *)
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        wOperatingState := 16#0028;
        wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR CROSSWIND_SEVERE_BIT;

        IF NOT bEnable OR tonSensorMismatchTimer.Q THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF bDegradedMode THEN
            iState := 50;
        ELSIF (ABS(rCrosswindForce_kN) <= 10.0) AND (tonStateTimer.ET > T#500MS) THEN
            wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT CROSSWIND_SEVERE_BIT;
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    50: (* --- STATE 50: DEGRADED SINGLE SENSOR FALLBACK MODE --- *)
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        wOperatingState := 16#0032;

        IF NOT bEnable OR tonSensorMismatchTimer.Q THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF NOT bDegradedMode THEN
            iState := 20; (* All sensors recovered healthy *)
        ELSIF ABS(rVotedLateralDispl_m) > 0.035 THEN
            iState := 80; (* Lateral limit near flange in degraded mode, abort to stop *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* --- STATE 80: CONTROLLED REGENERATIVE DYNAMIC DECELERATION --- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        wOperatingState         := 16#0050;
        rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := 0.0;

        (* Controlled ramping down of forward thrust *)
        rLsmTotalThrust_kN := 0.0;
        (* Continue lateral centering with reduced authority to prevent derailment *)
        rDifferentialForce_kN := LIMIT(-20.0, -(k_diff_y * 0.5 * x_hat_0) - (k_diff_psi * 0.5 * x_hat_2), 20.0);

        IF rLongitudinalVelocity_mps <= 0.05 THEN
            rDifferentialForce_kN := 0.0;
            rPortThrustCmd_kN     := 0.0;
            rStbdThrustCmd_kN     := 0.0;
            iState                := 99; (* Transition to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* --- STATE 90: EMERGENCY STOP DYNAMIC BRAKING --- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        wOperatingState         := 16#005A;
        bEmergencyBrakingActive := TRUE;
        rPortThrustCmd_kN       := 0.0;
        rStbdThrustCmd_kN       := 0.0;
        rDifferentialForce_kN   := 0.0;
        rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := 0.0;

        IF rLongitudinalVelocity_mps <= 0.02 THEN
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* --- STATE 99: CRITICAL FAULT LOCKOUT --- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        wOperatingState         := 16#0063;
        rPortThrustCmd_kN       := 0.0;
        rStbdThrustCmd_kN       := 0.0;
        rDifferentialForce_kN   := 0.0;
        rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := 0.0;

        IF bResetFault AND bEStopOk AND ((wDiagnosticWord AND TMR_SENSOR_COLLAPSE_BIT) = 0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset sequence permitted *)
        END_IF;

ELSE
    iState := 0;
END_CASE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 CONTROL LAW COMPUTATION: LQR/MPC DIFFERENTIAL THRUST & ACTIVE STEERING                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (iState = 20) OR (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40) OR (iState = 50) THEN
    (* 5.1 Feedforward Terms *)
    (* Kinematic Ackerman steering angle feedforward: delta_ff = L * kappa *)
    rFeedforwardSteer_rad := rWheelbase_L_m * rTrackCurvature_radpm;

    (* Inertial yaw torque feedforward during curve entry/exit: Mz = Jz * v * d_kappa/dt *)
    (* Guideway curvature feedforward moment converted to differential force *)
    rFeedforwardDifferential_kN := (rTotalMass_kg * EXPT(rLongitudinalVelocity_mps, 2) * rTrackCurvature_radpm * 0.001) * 0.25;

    (* Aerodynamic crosswind counter-torque feedforward: M_wind = F_wind * L_wind_arm *)
    (* Compensate wind yaw moment through differential thrust: Delta_F = M_wind / b *)
    rWindCompThrust_kN := (rCrosswindForce_kN * 1.85) / rBogieTrackHalfWidth_b_m;

    (* 5.2 Feedback Terms *)
    (* State feedback differential force for yaw stability and centerline keeping *)
    rDifferentialForce_kN := -( (k_diff_y * x_hat_0)
                              + (k_diff_ydot * x_hat_1)
                              + (k_diff_psi * x_hat_2)
                              + (k_diff_psidot * x_hat_3)
                              + (k_integral_y * rDisplacementIntegral_m_s) )
                              + rFeedforwardDifferential_kN
                              + rWindCompThrust_kN;

    (* Saturate differential force to structural and motor boundaries *)
    rDifferentialForce_kN := LIMIT(-rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN, rDifferentialForce_kN, rMaxDifferentialThrust_kN);

    (* Active Bogie Articulation Angle: Feedback + Kinematic Feedforward *)
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := -( (k_steer_y * x_hat_0)
                                + (k_steer_ydot * x_hat_1)
                                + (k_steer_psi * x_hat_2)
                                + (k_steer_psidot * x_hat_3) )
                                + rFeedforwardSteer_rad;

    (* Bogie mechanical physical angle saturation *)
    rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad := LIMIT(-rMaxSteeringAngle_rad, rBogieSteerAngleCmd_rad, rMaxSteeringAngle_rad);

    (* 5.3 Force Allocation to Port and Starboard Linear Synchronous Motors *)
    (* Total longitudinal thrust request *)
    rLsmTotalThrust_kN := LIMIT(0.0, rTargetThrust_kN, rMaxLSMThrust_kN * 1.80);

    (* Bilateral thrust allocation: F_port = 0.5*(F_tot - Delta_F), F_stbd = 0.5*(F_tot + Delta_F) *)
    rRawPortThrust_kN := (rLsmTotalThrust_kN * 0.5) - (rDifferentialForce_kN * 0.5);
    rRawStbdThrust_kN := (rLsmTotalThrust_kN * 0.5) + (rDifferentialForce_kN * 0.5);

    (* Anti-saturation priority logic: Maintain differential steering moment under high traction demand *)
    IF rRawPortThrust_kN > rMaxLSMThrust_kN THEN
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := rRawStbdThrust_kN - (rRawPortThrust_kN - rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
        rRawPortThrust_kN := rMaxLSMThrust_kN;
    ELSIF rRawStbdThrust_kN > rMaxLSMThrust_kN THEN
        rRawPortThrust_kN := rRawPortThrust_kN - (rRawStbdThrust_kN - rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := rMaxLSMThrust_kN;
    END_IF;

    (* Prevent reverse thrust during high-speed forward cruising unless braking commanded *)
    IF rTargetThrust_kN >= 0.0 THEN
        rRawPortThrust_kN := MAX(0.0, rRawPortThrust_kN);
        rRawStbdThrust_kN := MAX(0.0, rRawStbdThrust_kN);
    END_IF;

    (* 5.4 Slew Rate Limiting on Inverter Output Thrust (dF/dt <= 250 kN/s) *)
    rSlewClampedPort_kN := LIMIT(rPrevPortThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rRawPortThrust_kN, rPrevPortThrust_kN + rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN);
    rSlewClampedStbd_kN := LIMIT(rPrevStbdThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rRawStbdThrust_kN, rPrevStbdThrust_kN + rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN);

    IF (rSlewClampedPort_kN <> rRawPortThrust_kN) OR (rSlewClampedStbd_kN <> rRawStbdThrust_kN) THEN
        wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR ACTUATOR_SLEW_CLAMP_BIT;
    ELSE
        wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord AND NOT ACTUATOR_SLEW_CLAMP_BIT;
    END_IF;

    rPortThrustCmd_kN  := rSlewClampedPort_kN;
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN  := rSlewClampedStbd_kN;
    rPrevPortThrust_kN := rPortThrustCmd_kN;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN := rStbdThrustCmd_kN;
ELSIF (iState = 80) THEN
    (* Deceleration controlled ramping *)
    rPortThrustCmd_kN := LIMIT(0.0, rPrevPortThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
    rStbdThrustCmd_kN := LIMIT(0.0, rPrevStbdThrust_kN - rMaxSlewPerCycle_kN, rMaxLSMThrust_kN);
    rPrevPortThrust_kN := rPortThrustCmd_kN;
    rPrevStbdThrust_kN := rStbdThrustCmd_kN;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
